description: This file contains integration tests (indicated by the 'IT' suffix and annotations) for the paging functionality of search persistence in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies correct behavior of paging, limits, skipping, deletion effects, and default limit enforcement for querying Thing IDs.

classes.name: PagingIT
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying paging behavior in the search persistence layer of Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Sets up static test configuration before all tests, loading limits configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters before each test run.

methods.name: pageWithItemsCountLessThanLimit
methods.description: Tests paging when the number of items is less than the specified limit.

methods.name: pageWithItemsCountEqualToLimit
methods.description: Tests paging behavior when the number of items equals the limit.

methods.name: pageWithSkipAndLimitLessThanTotalItems
methods.description: Tests paging with skip and limit parameters where total items exceed skip.

methods.name: lastPageWithItemsCountLessThanLimit
methods.description: Verifies paging behavior on the last page with fewer items than the limit.

methods.name: lastPageWithItemsCountEqualToLimit
methods.description: Verifies paging with last page containing exactly the limit number of items.

methods.name: defaultLimitValue
methods.description: Checks that default limit is applied correctly when no explicit limit is set.

methods.name: limitValueExceedsMaximum
methods.description: Action expecting an exception when set limit exceeds maximum allowed.

methods.name: pageSkipsDeletedItems
methods.description: Ensures deleted items are skipped during paging results.

methods.name: assertPaging
methods.description: Utility method to verify paging results and next page offset.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Persists a collection of things into the database for testing.

methods.name: shuffleAndPersist
methods.description: Shuffles and persists a list of things for realistic test scenarios.

methods.name: executeVersionedQueryWithChangeOptions
methods.description: Executes a query with specified modifications for testing different query parameters.
